Objectives

Discussion Questions

  • What are the features and labels in this dataset?
  • Which side of the decision boundary predicts the +1 class, and which side predicts the -1 class?
  • If the hinge loss used 10 instead of 1 in max(0, 1 - t), how would that change what counts as 'safely classified'?
  • Which loss would you choose if you wanted to ignore large outliers more aggressively, and why?
  • How do hinge and logistic losses differ in how strongly they respond to far-away points?
